title: Mad Max: Fury Road
synopsis: A war rig, five wives, and a long road across a desert that goes both ways.

nodes.text: Hooks pull you down into a place that calls itself the Citadel.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Wild—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: The wheels lock, the gates open, and the Citadel learns it was always two days from kindness.
You slip down through the crowd before anyone can name you. The road goes both ways and you are not done being driven.
Nux's grin in the rearview, half a second before chrome. You will see it for the rest of your long, accidental life.
